_comment: Frozen Maelstrom arena (#102), read by scripts/arena/maelstrom_ground.gd. Game metres, Y up, arena centre at the origin. Gameplay values: changing any of them is a gameplay change (bump WireCodec.BUILD). The playable ice is a ring between the eye and the jagged rim, a rolling plateau that sags into a funnel toward the eye and rises to a lip at the rim (bowl), ringed by rim cliffs down to the frozen sea (sea_level) and falling into the bottomless eye (eye_depth). A bot whose origin drops below kill_y is eliminated (reason 'maelstrom') instead of being put back on its last floor; its wreck keeps falling onto the sea ice, or sinks sink_depth below kill_y in the eye. Obstacles are authored for one half and mirrored through the centre, with the fleets swapped, so both teams face identical ground. Model hulls come from data/maelstrom_hulls.json (art_source/maelstrom/build_kit.py).

bowl._comment: The frozen whirlpool's profile: the ice sags funnel_depth metres into the eye, easing out to the level plateau at funnel_outer metres from the centre, and rises lip_height metres from lip_start to the rim. Start pads are level at the plateau height (0).

swell._comment: Broad frozen swells following the spin: sin(2 * spiral phase) times height metres, fading near the eye and the rim.

ridge._comment: Two frozen spiral pressure ridges (log spirals r = eye_radius * exp(twist * angle), 180 degrees apart): a sharp tent profile height metres tall and half_width metres to each side of the crest, fading out near the eye and the rim.

slabs._comment: Upthrust ice slabs: rise along yaw from the ice to height over length, then drop sharply. Makeshift jump ramps.
